name: Twinkle ☆ Crusaders - Miracle Disc
original_name: ティンクル☆くるせいだーす ミラクルディスク
source: This is a fandisc to Twinkle ☆ Crusaders. It is a side story staged at an onsen with no relation to the main plot and does not feature any battle scenes. It also contains a harem ending and route for Amyrina.
translation: 《Twinkle☆Crusaders》的Fan Disc。故事是发生在温泉、与主线无关的外传，不包含任何战斗场景。另收录后宫结局与艾米莉娜路线。
